description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D1_zero_grad_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_zero_grad_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured steady solution cos(2 pi x) is held by the exact forcing c dGdx (derivation and the boundary-compatibility argument in the problem file); the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.02 are the pure spatial truncation drift of the 2nd-order centered interior plus 2nd-order one-sided zero-gradient faces, expected to fall as O(dx^2). The window is short (t=0.02) so the drift stays dominated by the O(dx^2) spatial error rather than the weakly growing boundary transient of the both-ends one-sided centered closure (problem metadata.description).
